profile.headline: Software Engineer at Blue Circle Health
profile.summary: I am a Colorado-based Software Developer who has fallen in love with the flexibility that coding in Javascript provides, and who especially enjoys working in Vue, Node, and Express. Problem solving and seeking out better and more efficient solutions in code are what I eagerly devote, and often lose, my time. I firmly believe that technology has the power of endless possibilities; from making tasks more efficient, to the exploration of new ideas, to the continuation of building and making better. A quick learner who is both feisty and mindful of the team environments that I contribute to, I am excited to continue to build and expand both my contributions and my knowledge.   Personal note for other gamers out there… While coding takes up the majority of my time, I was, and still am, an avid gamer that has been ranked in the top 100 in World of Warcraft, and as a 5-star general in the arcade game Area 51 (many quarters went towards this victory, at the sacrifice of laundry).

positions.description:

- Implemented end-to-end tests with Cypress framework for quality assurance and regression testing

positions.title: Retail Sales Associate / Web Content Manager
positions.description: Customer service, retail sales, inventory management, website content management, website UI, web traffic growth, SEO, marketing strategy, small-scale IT, and social media management. The Fig Leaf housed both a quilt shop and a home furnishings store. With a staff of less than 10 people, and a strong do-it-yourself culture, I was tasked with a little bit of everything involved in maintaining a successful small business.

projects.title: Craft Queue
projects.description: Productivity tool for Etsy sellers. Allows orders to be sorted by shipping deadline. Coming soon: production checklists for orders.

projects.title: Ghost Rush
projects.description:
An app to encourage exploration of Colorado ghost towns. Allows users to track which towns they want to go to and which towns they've visited.

My contributions included:
- Design and implementation of full stack logic for tracking user ghost town lists functionality, from database schema design to API endpoints to client interface
- Google Maps integration for interactive ghost town location mapping
- Logo design

Technologies:
Node/ExpressJS, PostgreSQL, Knex.js, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, Materialize
